title: Kromboost: Protein bioactive for hair longevity
summary: Kromboost is Provital's bioactive, upcycled hydrolyzed barley protein active, sourced from local malt rootlets. Rich in peptides, polyphenols and serine, it strengthens hair, boosts hydration and shields dyed colour from heat damage. Ex vivo studies show up to 152% less breakage and 199% better colour retention in leave-on, plus 166% in just one 3-minute rinse-off wash. Cosmos approved, Halal and Vegan certified, 100% natural origin. Used at 2%.
